analysis_grains.propensity: one AMC using 1970 census and aggregated 1970 municipal GDP covariates
analysis_grains.gdp_per_capita: AMC-aggregated GDP or value added divided by harmonized AMC census population
analysis_grains.mapbiomas: one AMC-year observation from MapBiomas Collection 11, 1985-2025
analysis_grains.gaez: one static AMC-crop observation from FAO/GAEZ v4, 1961-1990 climate normal

transformations.logs: natural logs of strictly positive constant-2010-R$ municipality values
transformations.per_capita: constant 2010 R$ per AMC resident in years with both GDP and census population
transformations.growth: 100 times the within-municipality log change divided by the elapsed years
transformations.mapbiomas_shares: land-cover hectares divided by mapped territory; hectare outcomes excluded
transformations.mapbiomas_display_years: 1985 and five-year intervals through 2025; the source panel remains annual
transformations.gaez: high-input rainfed all-land suitability on a 0-100 scale; eight crop-specific controls added to the inclusive PS model
